issues.detail: The Greek 'υμας' (you/plural) is the direct object of 'θλιβουσιν' (oppressing). The Vietnamese translation 'cho những kẻ gây hoạn nạn cho anh em' translates this as 'those who cause trouble for [your] brothers'. However, the Greek structure 'τοις θλιβουσιν υμας' means 'to those who oppress you'. The Vietnamese version shifts the target of the oppression from 'you' (the readers) to 'brothers' (anh em).
